result.description: A fictional compact tabletop audio mixer built for small podcast booths, synth performers, and live narration setups. It features 6 analog input channels, USB-C digital output, independent headphone monitoring, and a warm-sounding three-band EQ per channel. Designed as a studio utility rather than a storage or graphics product, the ArcDesk emphasizes tactile controls and simple routing for spoken-word and music workflows.
result.title: Orion Loomhaven ArcDesk audio mixer
